goal: Introduce additive file-structure protection that prevents accidental asset or scene loss during continual Godot production.
requirements: Preserve all existing Godot and art files, stable asset IDs, S.I.R.E. work orders and evidence
Add source-only portability, resource reference and UID checks
Compare pull request changes against the trusted base commit without weakening its original safety policy
Keep existing project and visual canon unchanged and support new additive scenes and models
No network dispatch, paid tools, auto-merge, destructive refactoring or fabricated runtime evidence
completion_criteria: Layout guard succeeds on original repository source
Adversarial tests reject existing asset moves, deletes, unsafe paths and stale resource references
New scenes and placeholder replacements succeed without requiring destructive migration
PR checks pass on the exact source commit and native Godot headless smoke remains green
Current approved art and project root untouched; actual graphical/device evidence remains NOT_RUN
rollback: Close stacked draft PR and keep its parent development branch unchanged. Never force-push, delete or rewrite originals.
